title: Independent audit of RULE-04 and Director-authorized integration into main
actor: Claude Code agent (architect/QA reviewer role) on Director request, local WSL session

changes.description: Audited Codex commit 808de78 (RULE-04, CHG-20261012-003/004/005) against the backlog acceptance (sourced expected results, negative cases, effect-bag/choices, new-keyword and invalid-state coverage), ADR0011, D10 and D11. Code review covered the test-only scenario build/runtime bridge, certification gate, schema/template, the 91 scenario oracles against the official CR2.3/CR2.2 text (1.13, 7.7.3-7.7.6, 8.14 and 8.16 read in full), boundary and governance-test changes, and every behavioral change in the 25 new and expanded patches: ink-drop payment planning, getAvailableInk callers, Adventurous challenge/end-of-turn checks, temporary keyword loss in the derived projection, Vanish recording through the actual chooser with a captured zone incarnation, removal of duplicate be-chosen emissions, slotted-target cardinality and counter generation. Requirement edits only add RULE-04 as prerequisite evidence; all 548 dispositions and scope counts are unchanged. Verdict: representative RULE-04 acceptance met.

Independent runs RUN-20261013-001..010 all passed at Codex final fingerprint 5f405778 with exact timing: verify:foundation (241 project checks = 217 Node + 24 Python, 338 upstream passes/1 inherited skip/838 expectations, 2 injection tests); importer reproduction (346 payloads, 53 patches); separate git cat-file byte audit (293 identical, 53 patched to ledger, licenses, 27 unchanged tests, no card/test patches, be-chosen helper outside the closure); official rule-source bytes; auditor rules probe with 16 CR2.3-sourced Adventurous/ink-drop/Vanish/bag cases and zero-mutation checks on rejections; the unchanged RULE-03 compiled-adapter probe on the new kernel; manual-move characterization; built-bundle scan (no test bridge in any kernel/Lab/server/app bundle); boundary probe (264 refused imports across 11 owners); Chromium 6 web scenarios and 2 Lab workers. RUN-20261013-013 docs:check covers this record.

Host isolated CI RUN-20261013-011 completed all 13 child stages with child exit 0 but the receipt failed clock_changed (265,558 ms wall vs 264,004 ms monotonic, 1,554 ms over the unchanged 1,000 ms guard); no result published; owned project/volume/network/image removed. Read-only RUN-20261013-012 sampled the clock for 60 s and saw the wall clock step forward 171.5 ms twice (343.7 ms/min), so the audit did not retry. CI timing qualification stays pending under the Director's leave-environment instruction; no clock, tolerance, service or environment change.

Findings recorded for later work, neither blocking the representative acceptance: (1) defect - after a static lose-keyword effect removes Adventurous, the challenge check honors the loss but the end-of-turn check still refuses passTurn (RUN005), to be fixed with a sourced regression before any Adventurous card admission; (2) pre-existing since RULE-02 - upstream manual/debug moves such as manualSetLore are accepted with player authority through the kernel bridge and server adapter, letting a player set lore and win (RUN007); admission is closed, and PLAY-01 needs a server move allowlist before any real match; (3) move enumeration is name-level and still lists passTurn under Adventurous/Reckless/must-quest obligations, while submission refuses it.

Removed a leading empty ";" entry from the ticket_ids and evidence_links fields of R01.009, R01.011, R01.016, R28.002, R28.003, R28.004, R28.005, R28.007, R28.010, R28.011 and R28.012 (introduced when RULE-04 was appended to empty fields). No other field or disposition changed.

Appended a dated audit section to docs/validation/rule-04.md and dated notes to ADR0011, the RULE-04 plan, the engine runbook (command-authority gap) and the rules-certification runbook (Adventurous static-loss defect). Updated AGENTS.md, README.md and docs/README.md current RULE-04 status, F-CI/F-ENGINE/F-RULE-CERTIFICATION descriptions/evidence, the FEATURES summary, the backlog evidence link and the handoff. The D11 selection is recorded by Codex; this auditor did not observe the original instruction.

Director-authorized integration: publish codex/rule-04-certification (808de78) and claude/rule-04-audit, then fast-forward main to the audit commit containing this record. Hosted CI for the integrated main commit is observed after the push and recorded in a later change.
